units: metres unless explicitly labelled frozen bone-local units

bodyFrame.origin: Hips joint centre in frozen neutral pose after the real loader transforms; freeze this frame relative to Hips once calibrated
bodyFrame.V: normalize(Spine joint centre - Hips joint centre)
bodyFrame.U: normalize((RightShoulder - LeftShoulder) minus its projection onto V)
bodyFrame.N: approved anterior: project headfront - Head perpendicular to U and V, normalize, then confirm nose/chest-facing sign against actual mesh and approved Sam image; reject degeneracy or anatomical mismatch
bodyFrame.handedness: Record determinant of [U,V,N]. Never infer anatomical right from world X or force a reflected frame into a quaternion. These anatomical axes are labels, not an assumed right-handed asset basis.
bodyFrame.rigidFrame: Do not recompute shoulder-based axes every animated frame. Fit once and transport with Hips.

attachment.region: right anterolateral waist armour, between torso and upper-leg articulation
attachment.scaleRule: Use complete actual-loader Hips world matrix, actor height/root conversions and determinant. Compute local attachment = inverse(hipsWorld) * desiredWorldMetreFrame. Preserve metre size without double unit conversion; Engine owns reflection/scale decomposition. Do not multiply frozen socket numbers by an assumed metre factor.

frameProposal.orthogonality: Reorthogonalize W = X cross V. [X,V,W] must have determinant +1. Local X is tangent, not anatomical-right U.

holderLocal.transformsStatus: exact authored local geometry only; NOT measured on Sam

clearance.anchorRule: Measure right-thigh swept surface and waist armour in fitted transfer poses; stored-card centre V must exceed maximum relevant thigh surface by >=0.075m; holder and complete hand/card/forearm envelope must also pass actual triangle contacts.
clearance.bodyEnvelope: Complete hand + card + forearm swept geometry plus 0.010m proposed margin; exact bounds pending measured pose. No wrist-only reach claim.
intendedContacts: holder backing OUTER face z=-0.0115 to selected waist armour patch only, fitted without deep penetration
stored card bottom edge y=-0.140 to bottom-stop inner top face only
clearance.risk: 13mm mouth is card-only. A preserved palm grip may require hand volume within the shell at the recessed endpoint. Stop as infeasible if exact grip cannot fit; do not alter grip, hide the card earlier, expand Sam, or call wrist reach clearance.
clearance.removalPath: First withdraw 0.150m along +V with full hand/forearm outside armour; only then turn outward around the U+N envelope toward ID_Ready. Reverse for insertion after endpoint fit.

preservedFrozenGrip.source: pinned opening-worker-sockets.json and credential-props.ts; grips.json only defines ed

custodyAndTiming.requirement: Single existing card; existing exact hide/reveal times; physical concealment verified in matching views. Top/oblique visibility is unverified. Current stowed card remains hidden by runtime; this proposal does not add a duplicate visible card.
